title: 第十五章 代号【夜魔】
novel_title: 方彻最快更新(长夜君主)
content_zh: 方彻认真背诵。不得不说，木林远的冰澈灵台，对于方彻来说，可说是一个宝藏。他只是听了一遍就知道，这门功法虽然没有别的作用，但是对于平静心态，保持沉稳，在任何环境中从容思考，乃是不二之选。比起自己前世修炼的‘冰心诀’要强上一筹。既然如此，这一把羊毛，那是非薅不可的。接下来，侯方传授了‘神猿掏心十三式’。而钱三江则是传授了一套‘幻骨易形’的功夫。“在江湖行走，危险重重，这门功法练至高深，可以随意改变身体形状与面貌，甚至连骨龄都能伪装改变，一共七重境界，我现在也只是练到了第二重，你好好修炼，这是行走江湖真正能保命的法门。”这一点，他不说，方彻也知道。所以对这门功法，完全没有任何小觑，并下定决心，一旦有机缘，必须要先将这‘幻骨易形’功法练到第七重！真正的保命功夫，这话，一点不假。看着钱三江，方彻也顿时明白，眼前这样子，也未必是钱三江真正容貌。想必这货，仗着这门功法，曾经无数次逃脱镇守者的追杀吧？哼，漏网之鱼！终于，足足两个时辰过去。六人终于从密室中出来。乃是一处偏僻的村庄。“镇守者快要来了。”印神宫回头看着刚出来的村庄，脸色阴冷：“每次教义洗礼，天蜈神的神念落下，镇守者都能循着气息追踪。这件事，我已经向总教汇报多次，始终不被放在心上。”“造就了我们的太多被动！”他拔剑出鞘，骤然一挥。轰的一声，一道剑气，迅雷一般冲进了村庄。几十户的小村庄，在这一剑之下，化作齑粉！剑气肆虐，男女老幼，一个不存。冲天的血腥味，弥漫而起。轰的一声，洗礼的地下密室，轰然塌陷。那一丝天蜈神神韵，也彻底消散。印神宫摸着手上的空间戒指，里面，是天蜈神神像。“现在就应该没事了。”木林远，孙元等人都是一脸放松，对于这种动辄屠戮数百人命的事情，他们早已经司空见惯。不以为奇。方彻脸上毫无表情。右手悄然攥起了拳头。一百多条人命，无冤无仇，与世无争，就这么瞬间惨死！没有任何理由的惨死。只是因为，印神宫要毁灭气息。但是，不屠杀这些人，也可以毁灭气息的，为什么非要这样做？他能看到，废墟中，一个年轻女子七窍流血，怀中还抱着一个一两岁的婴儿，母子二人，都已经失去了气息。死了。婴儿的脸惨白。不谙世事的眼睛还睁着。他还没明白，自己刚来到这個世界，还没有学会说话，为什么就已经遭遇了死亡。清澈的眼神，化作了死鱼一样的僵硬。印神宫转头，看着方彻毫无表情的脸。淡淡道：“方彻，你有什么想法？”方彻吸了一口气，道：“可以不杀他们，也能消除痕迹的。”他现在的面貌还是一个血气方刚的少年，有些愤懑，也是应该，所以他直接说出口，不在意印神宫会有什么看法。这才符合他现在的人设。也是借着这句话，将心中的愤怒发出来。印神宫冷冷道：“凡事，总有万一。而这么做，也是做给镇守者看的，以后，莫要追踪，否则，还会有更多人死！”“我们不会在乎死多少人，但是镇守者在乎。”“愚蠢的正义！呵呵……迂腐的镇守者。”印神宫看着方彻，道：“你现在年轻，而且刚刚洗礼，所以你的话，我不会怪你。但是，若是你在经过了一段时间锤炼之后，还说出这句话，我就会杀了你！”“因为，我们一心教面对的是天下高手，任何一点疏忽，都有可能导致我们六人一个也活不下去。”“我们进来的时候虽然没见到人，但是保不准就有人从门缝里看到了我们的模样。而这个模样，就有可能在某一天我们疏忽的时候，被镇守者盯上，从而死的不明不白。”“但凡有万一的可能暴露，我都不会放过他们。”印神宫微笑着，但眼神寒彻，看着方彻说道：“我问你，这个世界上，谁的性命最重要？”“谁的性命最重要？”方彻默然。印神宫冷喝：“抬起头，看着我的眼睛！”方彻抬头，看到了一双冷酷无情的眼睛。如食尸鹫一般。印神宫道：“这个世界上，我的性命最重要！我！懂了么？”方彻点头：“是，这个世界上，我的性命最重要！我没命了，什么都没了！”“孺子可教！”印神宫转身而行：“你要时刻记住这一点！”孙元带着方彻，几人速度极快，瞬间就到了一座小山顶上。便在这时，只听见远方，小村落的方向，传来一声震天的悲愤长啸。“镇守者的人来了。”印神宫嘲讽道：“可惜，太晚了些。”他转身，看着方彻道：“听说你想要燃血术？”“是。”印神宫负手前行，道：“你若是这次以东南路第一名的成绩，进入镇守武院，我便做主，给你五百贡献值，并且再给伱减免其他，让你学到燃血术。”孙元在一边道：“还不多谢教主。”“多谢教主恩典。”“恩，既然你已经入教，成了自己人，将来执行任务，总要有个代号才是，总不能以本来姓名招摇出现。”
content_en: Fang Che recited it carefully.It has to be said that the Bingche Lingtai in Mulinyuan can be said to be a treasure for Fang Che.He knew after just listening to it once that although this technique had no other effect, it was the best choice for calming the mind, staying calm, and thinking calmly in any environment.It is much stronger than the 'Bing Xin Jue' that I practiced in my previous life.In this case, this handful of wool must be harvested.Next, Hou Fang taught the ‘Thirteen Moves of the Divine Ape to Dig the Heart’.Qian Sanjiang taught a set of "phantom bone and shape-changing" skills."Walking in the rivers and lakes is full of dangers. If you practice this skill to such an advanced level, you can change the shape and appearance of your body at will. You can even disguise your bone age. There are seven levels in total. I have only reached the second level now. You practice well. This is the method that can truly save your life when walking in the rivers and lakes." He didn't say this, but Fang Che also knew it.Therefore, I do not underestimate this skill at all, and I am determined that once I have the opportunity, I must first practice this 'phantom bone shape-changing' skill to the seventh level!This is a true life-saving skill.Looking at Qian Sanjiang, Fang Che also immediately understood that the look in front of him may not be Qian Sanjiang's true appearance.Presumably this guy, relying on this skill, has escaped from the guards countless times, right?Humph, a fish slipped through the net!Finally, two full hours passed.Six people finally came out of the secret room.It is a remote village."The guardian is coming soon." Yin Shen Palace looked back at the village that had just come out, with a cold expression: "Every time the doctrine is baptized, and the divine will of God Centipede falls, the guardian can follow the breath. I have reported this matter to the head teacher many times, but it has never been taken to heart." "It has created too much passivity in us!" He unsheathed his sword and swung it suddenly.With a bang, a sword energy rushed into the village like lightning.A small village with dozens of households was turned into powder under this sword!The sword energy was raging, and no one, male, female, old or young was left alive.The smell of blood filled the sky.With a bang, the underground secret room of the baptism collapsed.That trace of the divine charm of the Heavenly Centipede also completely dissipated.Yinshen Palace touched the space ring on his hand. Inside, there was the statue of God Centipede."It should be fine now." Mu Linyuan, Sun Yuan and others all looked relaxed. They were already used to this kind of killing of hundreds of people.Not surprised.Fang Che had no expression on his face.His right hand quietly clenched his fist.More than a hundred human lives, without any injustice or hatred, without fighting against the world, died tragically in such an instant!A tragic death for no reason.Just because the Yin Shen Palace wants to destroy the aura.However, it is possible to destroy the aura without massacring these people, so why must we do this?He could see that in the ruins, a young woman was bleeding from all her orifices, and she was holding a one- or two-year-old baby in her arms. Both mother and child had lost their breath.dead.The baby's face was pale.The eyes that are not familiar with the world are still open.He still didn't understand why he had already met death when he had just arrived in this world and before he had learned to speak.His clear eyes turned as stiff as a dead fish.Yinshen Palace turned his head and looked at Fang Che's expressionless face.He said calmly: "Fang Che, what do you think?" Fang Che took a breath and said, "You can eliminate the traces without killing them." He still looked like a vigorous young man, a little angry, which was right, so he said it directly, not caring what Yin Shen Palace would think.This is in line with his current personality.It is also through these words that the anger in my heart is expressed.Yinshen Palace said coldly: "Everything must be prepared for eventuality. And this is also done for the guardians to see. Don't follow them in the future, otherwise, more people will die!" "We don't care how many people die, but the guardians do." "Stupid justice! Haha... pedantic guardians" Yinshen Palace looked at Fang Che and said, "You are young now and have just been baptized, so I won't blame you for what you said.But if you still say this after a period of tempering, I will kill you!" "Because we, Yixin Sect, are facing the world's masters."Any slightest care may result in none of the six of us surviving.""Although we didn't see anyone when we came in, there is a chance that someone might have seen our appearance through the crack of the door. If we are careless one day, we may be guarded.""I will not let them go if there is any chance of being exposed."Yinshen Palace looked at Fang Che with a smile and said, "Let me ask you, whose life is the most important in this world?""Whose life is the most important?"Yinshen Palace shouted coldly: "Raise your head and look into my eyes!" Fang Che looked up and saw a pair of cold and ruthless eyes.Like a corpse vulture.Yinshen Palace said: "In this world, my life is the most important! Me! Do you understand?" Fang Che nodded: "Yes, in this world, my life is the most important! I am dead, I have nothing!" "You can teach me!" Yinshen Palace turned around and said, "You must always remember this!" Sun Yuan led Fang Che, and they reached the top of a hill in an instant.At this moment, a loud roar of grief and anger was heard in the distance, in the direction of the small village."The Guardian's people are here." Yinshen Palace mocked: "Unfortunately, it's too late." He turned around, looked at Fang Che and said, "I heard you want the blood-burning technique?" "Yes." Yinshen Palace put his hands behind his hands and moved forward, saying: "If you enter the Guard Martial Academy this time with the first place on the Southeast Road, I will make the decision and give you five hundredContribute points, and let you learn the Blood Burning Technique."Sun Yuan said on the side: "Thank you very much, Master." "Well, since you have joined the religion and become one of my own, you must have a code name when you perform tasks in the future.You cannot show up under your original name."
